verdict.rationale: Missive's docs show building blocks that could be combined into priority-based views — rules/automation (up to 1000 rules), team spaces, shared/team inboxes, and search filters (Type, date range) — but there is no direct documentation of a dedicated 'streams' or custom-inbox-segmentation feature that lets a user split one inbox into important/team/newsletters/calendar-invite views for priority-ordered triage. Missing for 10: explicit feature docs on creating multiple filtered inbox views or 'focused streams', evidence of newsletter/calendar-invite specific segmentation, and independent confirmation that rules-based views work this way in practice.
